note: Adapted from the English original of Bourguignon et al. (2008); new species (sp. nov.), the diagnostic characters being the Diagnosis of the original. Measurements follow TABLE 13 (3 male and 1 female alates) and TABLE 14 (7 soldiers of the type colony plus 1 soldier of colony ANIC #10–11020), the parenthetical values being the single values of the second column. TABLE 18 lists head width only for the worker, the other worker measurements not being listed. Locality, type specimens, specimens examined and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: This species is distinguished from the other New Guinean species of the genus by its very small body size and the slight swelling of the soldier frons: soldier head length less than 2 mm, with a small swelling on the frons, whereas the other New Guinean species all have head length exceeding 2 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body small. Head capsule elongate, the posterior part rounded, the anterior part slightly narrower than the posterior, with about 60 long setae. The head rises vertically above the fontanelle, similar to Discupiditermes. Labrum short, with several setae. Postmentum deep, narrow and long, its maximum width about 2.5 times its minimum width. Antennae 14-segmented. Thorax and abdomen rather densely hairy. Measurements (7 individuals of the type colony; parenthetical values for 1 individual of colony ANIC #10–11020): head length to anterolateral corner of gena 1.69–1.84 mm (1.77), head depth including postmentum 0.80–0.87 mm (0.90), maximum head width 0.95–1.06 mm (1.04), head width at the anterolateral corner of the gena 0.75–0.89 mm (0.83), right mandible length 1.13–1.30 mm (1.30), left mandible length 1.11–1.24 mm (1.31), maximum postmentum width 0.27–0.35 mm (0.33), minimum postmentum width 0.09–0.14 mm (0.13), pronotal width 0.46–0.52 mm (0.53).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: The surface of each enteric valve cushion bears about 10 small triangular spines. Measurements: head width 0.880–0.943 mm (10 workers from 1 colony).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Body densely hairy throughout. Head capsule with many short setae and a few long setae. Compound eyes very large. Ocelli very large, close to the compound eye but not touching it. Pronotum densely hairy, broader anteriorly than posteriorly. Antennae 15-segmented. Measurements (3 males and 1 female from 1 colony; parenthetical values for the female): body length with wings 10.95–11.79 mm (11.41), body length without wings 5.67–6.42 mm (6.03), head length to apex of labrum 1.25–1.37 mm (1.30), head length to frontoclypeal suture 0.68–0.74 mm (0.75), head width including compound eyes 1.12–1.20 mm (1.12), maximum diameter of compound eye 0.37–0.38 mm (0.42), maximum length of ocellus 0.17–0.19 mm (0.17), pronotal length 0.49–0.53 mm (0.54), pronotal width 0.90–0.95 mm (0.89), forewing length 8.66–9.46 mm (9.48), forewing width 2.28–2.51 mm (2.39).
